article_content: Ukraine has suspended one of its top Olympic officials following allegations that he offered to sell up to 100 tickets for the London 2012 Games on the black market. The claims emerged from an undercover investigation by the BBC, which recorded Volodymyr Gerashchenko, a senior member of the Ukraine National Olympic Committee (UNOC), stating he would prioritize a ticket dealer in the event of excess tickets. Gerashchenko, who has served with UNOC since 1997, was informed of his suspension by UNOC President Sergey Bubka, the former Olympic pole vault champion. In a public statement, Bubka emphasized his commitment to ethical standards within the Olympic Movement, calling the allegations deeply concerning. He confirmed he had contacted London 2012 Chairman Sebastian Coe and pledged full cooperation with any ensuing investigation. Bubka added that UNOC had never held a surplus of tickets and that all allocations were distributed through official channels. 'London 2012 is going to be a spectacular celebration of sport,' he said, 'and it is imperative that tickets are distributed to deserving recipients.' However, Viktor Korzh, Bubka’s deputy, expressed skepticism, telling reporters he doubted the credibility of the BBC’s report and believed the story might ultimately amount to nothing. In response to the accusations, Gerashchenko reportedly clarified that he never intended to sell tickets in the UK, describing his comments as diplomatic language meant to placate a persistent ticket dealer.

Bubka la også til at UNOC aldri hadde hatt overskudd av billetter og at alle tildelingene ble distribuert gjennom offisielle kanaler. 'London 2012 vil være en spektakulær feiring av idrett,' sa han, 'og det er avgjørende at billetter distribueres til verdige mottakere.' Imidlertid uttrykte Viktor Korzh, Bubkas nestleder, skepsis og fortalte journalister at han tvilte på troverdigheten til BBCs rapport og mente at historien kanskje ikke skulle vise seg å ha noe grunnlag. article_content: For decades, only a select few hundred astronauts have had the privilege of gazing upon Earth from the void of space. Now, thanks to a remarkable initiative by NASA, anyone with an internet connection can share that breathtaking view. The High Definition Earth Viewing (HDEV) experiment, mounted on the exterior of the International Space Station, streams live video of our planet as it hurtles through orbit. Four rugged, off-the-shelf HD cameras—housed in a sealed nitrogen-filled box to shield them from extreme conditions—are positioned to capture different angles: one facing downward, one forward, and two looking backward. They rotate automatically, each taking turns for precise intervals to keep the feed dynamic and informative. When the ISS passes over the night side of Earth, the screen goes dark—no malfunction, just physics. Signal interruptions happen occasionally, but overall, the stream runs smoothly. What makes this even more special? U.S. high school students helped design parts of the system through NASA’s HUNCH program and even help operate it remotely. The cameras don’t zoom or pan—they simply capture what’s below as the station zips along at nearly 28,000 kilometers per hour, completing a full circle around Earth every 93 minutes. Since its launch aboard a SpaceX Dragon capsule in April 2014, HDEV has captured over 88,000 orbits and kept humanity connected to the blue marble we call home. Later this year, another project called Urthecast will arrive on the ISS, offering viewers the chance to actively explore Earth with zoom and pan controls. For now, though, all you need is curiosity—and maybe a cup of coffee—to watch the world spin beneath you.

Høyoppløst jordvisning (HDEV)-eksperimentet, montert på utsiden av Den internasjonale romstasjonen, sender live-video av vår planet mens den dytter seg gjennom banen. Fire robuste, kommersielle HD-kameraer—huset i en lufttett boks fylt med tørr nitrogen for å beskytte dem mot ekstreme vilkår—er plassert for å fange ulike vinkler: ett nede, ett foran og to bak. Signalbrudd skjer av og til, men ellers kjører strømmen smertefritt. Hva som gjør dette enda mer spesielt? Amerikanske videregående elever hjalp med å designe deler av systemet gjennom NASAs HUNCH-program og hjelper også med å operere det fra jorden. Kameraene har ikke zoom eller pansjon—de fanger bare det som er under mens stasjonen dytter seg med nesten 28.000 kilometer i timen og fullfører en hel runde rundt Jorden hvert 93. minutt. Siden dens lansering ombord i en SpaceX Dragon-kapsel i april 2014 har HDEV fanget over 88.000 baner og holdt menneskeheten forbundet med den blå kula vi kaller hjem. Senere dette året vil et annet prosjekt kalt Urthecast ankomme ISS og gi publikum muligheten til aktivt å utforske Jorden med zoom og pansjon. For nå, så trenger du bare nysgjerrighet—og kanskje en kopp kaffe—for å se verden snurre under deg.

article_content: London, England (CNN) — British troops will receive new camouflage uniforms for the first time in over 40 years, based on computer modeling of Afghanistan’s terrain, the Ministry of Defence announced on Sunday. The 'Multi-Terrain Pattern,' as the military has named the new design, is the first new pattern developed by the Ministry since 1968. It was specifically engineered for Afghanistan’s Helmand Province, where British forces have suffered heavy casualties this year. More than 100 British troops died in Afghanistan in 2009, making it the deadliest year for UK forces in decades. The new pattern was developed in just six months under an 'urgent operational requirement' project costing £250,000 ($400,000). 'This new camouflage will help our troops blend into the varied environments of Helmand Province to remain hidden from the Taliban,' said Defence Secretary Bob Ainsworth. The project incorporated aerial and scientific imagery from Afghanistan to determine optimal colors and brightness levels. These were then input into computer models to replicate the Green Zone, desert, and mixed terrains of the region. Uniforms in the new pattern will initially be issued to troops from the 4th Mechanised Brigade deploying to Afghanistan in March, with a full rollout across all three armed services beginning in 2011.

Den 'Multi-Terrain Pattern', som militæret har navngitt det nye mønsteret, er det første nye mønsteret utviklet av ministeriet siden 1968. Det nye mønsteret ble utviklet på bare seks måneder under et prosjekt med 'urgent operational requirement' og en kostnad på 250.000 pund (400.000 dollar). 'Denne nye kamouflasjen vil hjelpe våre tropper å blande seg inn i de varierte miljøene i Helmand-provinsen for å forbli usynlige for Taliban,' sa forsvarsminister Bob Ainsworth. Prosjektet inkluderte luftfotografi og vitenskapelig bildeanalyse fra Afghanistan for å finne de optimale fargene og deres lysstyrke. Disse ble så lagt inn i datamodeller for å reprodusere Grønnsonen, ørkenen og de blandede terrengetypene i regionen. Klær med det nye mønsteret vil først bli utdelt til tropper fra 4. mekaniserte brigade som skal deployes til Afghanistan i mars, med en full utvikling til alle tre våpengrenene fra 2011.

article_content: Michael van Gerwen is setting his sights on redemption. After losing his last two encounters to Terry Jenkins at Alexandra Palace, the reigning world champion is determined not to let history repeat itself. Though he acknowledges he hasn’t been firing on all cylinders in his opening matches — narrowly defeating Joe Cullen and Sascha Stein — he remains convinced that when he’s fully locked in, he’s simply the better player. 'I know I’m better than him,' Van Gerwen said. 'When I play my game at 100%, I will win. But reaching that level? That’s the hard part.' Meanwhile, Jenkins, 51, is riding a wave of quiet confidence. He nearly nailed a perfect nine-dart leg in his last outing against Laurence Ryder and feels more in tune with his game than ever. Unlike younger competitors who overtrain and burn out, Jenkins says he’s learned to trust his instincts. 'I used to practice 10 hours a day and still choke on stage,' he chuckled. 'Now I do two, stay calm, and let it flow.' The veteran also brought back his trademark moustache — shaved off last year by James Wade at a charity event — believing it restored his mojo after a slump in the Players Championships. 'People kept asking where it went,' he said. 'So I grew it back… just for this tournament. I’ll shave it off right after.' Despite the age gap and contrasting styles, both men agree: this isn’t about reputation. It’s about focus. 'You don’t think about who’s across the oche,' Jenkins noted. 'You just go out there and win one game.' Van Gerwen echoes that sentiment, admitting nerves are higher this year — not because he’s scared, but because everyone else sees him as the target. 'I feel good,' he said. 'My best is still in here. Monday night, it’s coming out.'

'Jeg vet jeg er bedre enn ham,' sa Van Gerwen. 'Når jeg spiller mitt spill på 100 %, vil jeg vinne. Men å nå det nivået? Det er det vanskelige.' Samtidig er Jenkins, 51, i full fart med rolig selvtillit. Han nesten traff en perfekt ni-dart-finale i sin siste kamp mot Laurence Ryder og føler seg mer i takten med spillet enn noensinne. I motsetning til yngre spillere som trener for mye og brenner ut, sier Jenkins at han har lært å stole på intuisjonen sin. 'Jeg trente tidligere 10 timer om dagen og fortsatt tapt på banen,' lo han. 'Min beste versjon er fortsatt inne. Mandag kveld kommer den ut.'

article_content: On Sunday morning, the Norwegian Breakaway cruise ship became stranded in the Hudson River due to a malfunction in its steering and propulsion systems, according to the U.S. Coast Guard. After being stuck since approximately 7:45 a.m., the vessel was towed by a tugboat, as ordered by Captain of the Port Gordon Loebl, and finally docked at Pier 88 on Manhattan’s West Side around 10 a.m. The ship, which had just completed a week-long Caribbean cruise, was originally scheduled to arrive at 7 a.m. Passengers reported long delays and disorganized disembarkation. Many waited in crowded lines for hours, leading to tensions as people attempted to cut in front of others. Security personnel were called in to manage the queues and shut down elevators temporarily due to overcrowding. One passenger, Roy, anxiously awaited the ship’s arrival after learning his father had suffered a heart attack onboard. Other passengers described the scene as chaotic and poorly managed, with verbal altercations breaking out upon exit. Norwegian Cruise Line, however, downplayed the incident, attributing the delay to strong river currents rather than acknowledging the mechanical failure noted by the Coast Guard. Spokesperson AnneMarie Mathews thanked guests for their patience and confirmed that the next scheduled sailing to Bermuda would depart later that day at 5 p.m. The exact number of passengers aboard was not disclosed, though the ship has a capacity of more than 4,000 guests.

Skipet, som akkurat hadde fullført en ukelang karibisk kryssertur, skulle opprinnelig ankomme kl. 07:00. Passasjerene rapporterte lange ventetider og uorganisert utstigning. Mange ventet i travle køer i timer, noe som førte til spenninger da folk forsøkte å skjære foran i køen. Sikkerhetspersonell ble hentet inn for å håndtere køene og stenge ned hevene midlertidig på grunn av overbelastning. En passasjer, Roy, ventet spenningsfylt ved kaien etter å ha fått beskjed om at faren hans hadde fått hjerteinfarkt ombord. Andre passasjerer beskrev scenen som kaotisk og dårlig koordinert, med verbale konflikter som brøt ut ved utstigning. Norwegian Cruise Line nedtonet likevel hendelsen og la skylden på sterke strømmer i elven, istedenfor å anerkjenne den tekniske feilen som kystvakten hadde identifisert. Spreker AnneMarie Mathews takket passasjerene for tålmodigheten og bekreftet at den neste planlagte turen til Bermuda skulle avgå samme dag klokken 17:00. Det ble ikke oppgitt hvor mange passasjerer som var ombord, men skipet har en kapasitet på mer enn 4.000 gjester.

article_content: In the historic town of Newark-on-Trent, archaeologists have uncovered a remarkably intact green glass bottle — buried underground for over 300 years. Believed to date from around 1680, this artifact is a 'witch bottle,' a protective charm once used to fend off malevolent spirits and curses. These bottles were typically filled with deeply personal items like strands of hair, clipped fingernails, and even urine, all chosen to create a magical link between the homeowner and the object, trapping harmful forces before they could enter the home. The bottle was carefully placed during its burial, likely beneath a hearth or near a doorway — locations thought to be vulnerable entry points for witches. Fireplaces, in particular, were believed to connect directly to the heavens, making them prime targets for supernatural intrusion. Other common additions to witch bottles included bent iron nails, thorns, animal bones, needles, and scraps of fabric, each imbued with symbolic power to repel evil. The find occurred during renovations at the Old Magnus Buildings, a site originally established in 1529 when Reverend Thomas Magnus funded a local grammar school. Today, the Grade II-listed complex — which includes the surviving Tudor Hall, a Georgian extension, and a Victorian schoolroom — is being transformed into the UK’s first National Civil War Centre, thanks to a £3.5 million grant from the Heritage Lottery Fund. The bottle is expected to go on public display when the museum opens next spring. Will Munford of Pre-construct Archaeological Services noted how deeply superstition shaped daily life in the 17th and 18th centuries. 'People weren’t just being dramatic — they genuinely believed these rituals kept their families safe,' he said. This practice wasn't unique to England; it traveled across the Atlantic with settlers and became part of broader Western folk traditions. The Newark bottle offers a rare, untouched glimpse into the quiet, desperate hopes of ordinary people trying to protect their homes from forces they couldn’t see — but feared profoundly.

Disse flaskene ble vanligvis fylt med personlige gjenstander som hårstrå, klippet negler og selv urin, alle valgt for å skape en magisk kobling mellom hjemmets eier og gjenstanden, og fange skadelige krefter før de kunne komme inn i huset. Flaska ble forsiktig plassert under begravelsen, sannsynligvis under et peis eller nær en dør — steder som ble trodd å være utsatte innganger for hekser. Peiser, spesielt, ble trodd å ha en direkte kobling til himmelen, og dermed være ideelle innganger for overnaturlige trusler. Andre vanlige tilsetninger til hekseskråer inkluderte bukete jernnailer, tørner, dyrebener, nåler og skrått stoff, hver med symbolisk kraft for å avvise ondskap. Funnet skjedde under renovering av Old Magnus Buildings, et område opprinnelig etablert i 1529 da prest Thomas Magnus finansiert en lokal grammarskole. I dag omdannes den liste II-verdige komplekset — som inkluderer den bevarte Tudor Hall, en georgiansk utvidelse og en victoriansk skolesal — til Storbritannias første nasjonale borgerkrigssenter, takket være en støtte på 3,5 millioner pund fra Heritage Lottery Fund. Flaska forventes å vises offentlig når museet åpner neste vår. Will Munford ved Pre-construct Archaeological Services påpekte hvor dypt troldom og overtro præget dagliglivet på 1600- og 1700-tallet. 'Mennesker var ikke bare dramatiske — de trodde virkelig disse ritualene holdt familien sine trygge,' sa han. Denne tradisjonen var ikke unik for England; den reiste over Atlanterhavet sammen med emigranter og ble en del av bredere vestlige folketroer. Hekseskråen fra Newark gir et sjeldent, uberørt innblikk i de stille, desperat håpene til vanlige mennesker som forsøkte å beskytte sine hjem mot krefter de ikke kunne se — men fryktet dypt.

article_content: For over two decades, Marco Grass — a quiet Swiss ski instructor — has been the steady presence behind Carol Thatcher, rarely seen in public but deeply relied upon in private. Though he first entered her life on the slopes of Klosters in 1992, his role grew far beyond that of a ski coach. He became her confidant, caretaker, and emotional anchor, especially after a serious skiing accident left him with broken legs, which Carol helped him recover from. At the funeral of her mother, former Prime Minister Margaret Thatcher, Marco was by Carol’s side throughout, offering silent strength as she struggled with grief. In stark contrast, her twin brother Mark, with whom she has had minimal contact for years, shared only fleeting physical contact with her during the ceremony. Their estrangement, rooted in childhood loyalties — Carol closer to her father, Mark to their mother — left her feeling isolated, making Marco’s presence all the more vital. Marco, who once lived in Carol’s Fulham flat and was playfully called her ‘lodger,’ has always shunned publicity, following the advice of Sir Denis Thatcher: stay out of the spotlight. He even teased Lady Thatcher about Switzerland joining the EU, just to hear her rant — a small, affectionate ritual. Despite his low profile, he is known in Klosters as a warm host and skilled organizer, and the couple owns a cozy apartment there, alongside one in Madrid where Carol is learning Spanish. Their return journey from the funeral? An EasyJet flight, perfectly in keeping with the frugal spirit of the Iron Lady herself. Lady Thatcher, aware of how much joy Marco brought to her daughter, would have approved — not because he was famous, but because he was kind, humble, and truly there.

Han ble hennes tillitsperson, omsorgsperson og emosjonell anker, spesielt etter en alvorlig skisulykke som la ham med brudd i begge beina, noe Carol hjalp ham å komme seg fra. Ved begravelsen av moren sin, den tidligere statsministeren Margaret Thatcher, var Marco ved Carol sin side hele tiden og ga henne stilt styrke mens hun kjempet med sorg. I skarp kontrast til søskenbroren hennes Mark, med hvem hun har hatt minimal kontakt i årer, delte hun bare et kort fysisk kontaktpunkt med ham under seremonien. Deres fremmedgjøring, rotet i barndomsloyaliteter — Carol nærmere faren, Mark moren — lot henne føle seg isolert, og gjorde Marco's tilstedeværelse viktigere enn noensinne. Marco, som tidligere bodde i Carols leilighet i Fulham og ble latterlig kalt hennes 'gjest', har alltid unngått oppmerksomhet, og fulgt rådet fra Sir Denis Thatcher: hold deg utenfor lyset. Han skolet Lady Thatcher selv om Sveits skulle bli med i EU, bare for å høre henne skrike — en liten, kjærlig rutine. Trods hans lavprofil, er han kjent i Klosters som en varm vert og dyktig arrangør, og paret eier et koselig leilighet der, samt en annen i Madrid hvor Carol lærer seg spansk. Deres hjemreise fra begravelsen? En EasyJet-flyvning, fullt i tråd med den sparsommelige ånden til Jernkvinnen selv. Lady Thatcher, som visste hvor mye glede Marco ga datteren sin, ville ha godkjent det — ikke fordi han var berømt, men fordi han var snill, beskjeden og virkelig der.

article_content: According to a team of international researchers, part of the melting observed in Greenland’s ice sheet is driven by heat rising from the Earth’s mantle—a connection never before established. Their findings, published in Nature Geoscience, suggest that geothermal activity plays a critical, previously overlooked role in ice dynamics and must be integrated into future climate models. The Greenland ice sheet contains enough ice to raise global sea levels by more than seven meters if entirely melted. Over the past decade, ice loss has accelerated, with roughly half attributed to surface melting due to warmer air temperatures and the remainder to increased iceberg calving—the process by which chunks of ice break off glaciers and float away. Led by the GFZ German Research Centre for Geosciences, the IceGeoHeat project modeled interactions between the ice sheet and the underlying lithosphere. Researchers discovered that variations in the composition and thickness of the upper mantle and crust directly influence basal melting rates: some regions experience intense melting at the ice base, while adjacent areas remain frozen solid. Scientists Alexey Petrunin and Irina Rogozhina combined decades of ice core, magnetic, and seismic data with a novel thermo-mechanical model of the Greenland lithosphere. Simulating three million years of Earth history, they demonstrated that the temperature at the ice-bedrock interface results from a complex interplay between geothermal heat flow and glacial climate cycles. The lithosphere beneath central Greenland is exceptionally thin—only 70 to 80 kilometers—and dates back 1.7 to 2.8 billion years, making it one of Earth’s oldest and most thermally conductive crustal regions. This geological uniqueness amplifies heat transfer upward, accelerating localized melting. Meanwhile, a separate line of inquiry explores geoengineering as a potential remedy. David Keith, a professor at Harvard University, has proposed injecting reflective particles into the stratosphere to reduce incoming sunlight by just 0.5%, potentially restoring Arctic sea ice to pre-industrial levels. His models suggest this could be achieved using a handful of modified Gulfstream jets at an estimated annual cost of $8 billion. While Keith acknowledges the technical feasibility, he stops short of advocating for deployment, emphasizing that such interventions should not replace efforts to reduce greenhouse gas emissions.

Deres funn, publisert i Nature Geoscience, tyder på at geotermisk aktivitet spiller en kritisk, tidligere oversett rolle i isdynamikk og må integreres i fremtidige klimamodeller. Grønlands isskjell inneholder nok is til å heve havnivået med mer enn syv meter hvis den helt smelter. De siste ti årene har is tapet økt, hvor omtrent halvparten skyldes overflate-smelting på grunn av varmere lufttemperaturer og resten til økt isfjellkalving – prosessen der bitar is løsner fra isbreer og driver bort. Under ledelse av GFZ Tysk forskningscenter for geovidenskaper har IceGeoHeat-prosjektet modellert interaksjonene mellom isskjellet og den underliggende lithosfæren. Forskerne oppdaget at variasjoner i sammensetningen og tykkelsen av mantelen og skorpen direkte påvirker smeltingsrater ved isens bunn: noen områder opplever intens smelting ved isens base, mens naboområder forblir frostfaste. Forskerne Alexey Petrunin og Irina Rogozhina kombinerte årtier med iskjerner, magnetiske og seismiske data med en ny termomekanisk modell av Grønlands lithosfære. Ved å simulere tre millioner år med jordens historie viste de at temperaturen ved is-bunn-grensen er resultatet av et komplekst samspill mellom geotermisk varmestrøm og glasielle klimacykler. Lithosfæren under sentral Grønland er ekstremt tynn – bare 70 til 80 kilometer – og er 1,7 til 2,8 milliarder år gammel, noe som gjør den til en av jordens eldste og varmeledende skorper. Denne geologiske unikheten forsterker varmetransport oppover og akselererer lokal smelting. Mens dette utforsker en separat linje med forskning geoingeniørløsninger som et potensielt midler. David Keith, professor ved Harvard University, har foreslått å injisere reflekterende partikler i stratosfæren for å redusere innkommende sollys med kun 0,5 %, noe som potensielt kan gjenopprette Arktisk havis til nivåer fra før industrialiseringen. Hans modeller antyder at dette kan oppnås med et fåtall modifiserte Gulfstream-jets til en estimert årlig kostnad på 8 milliarder dollar. Mens Keith anerkjenner den tekniske muligheten, unngår han å anbefale implementering, og understreker at slike inngrep ikke skal erstatte anstrengelser for å redusere drivhusgassutslipp.

article_content: Just five months after giving birth to her first child, a girl named Mary-Jane, Catherine Tyler stepped onto the stage at one of Australia’s biggest bodybuilding competitions. With washboard abs and a muscular physique that turned heads, there were no signs that the 31-year-old had only ten weeks to prepare for an event many others spent a year training for. 'It was so rewarding and empowering to be in control of my body and my appearance,' Ms. Tyler told Daily Mail Australia. Sydney mum Catherine Tyler—pictured left a few days before giving birth—competed in a bodybuilding competition just five months after the arrival of her first child (pictured right, four weeks postpartum). Ms. Tyler trained with weights until she was eight and a half months pregnant and did cardio until the day before she gave birth. She was coached by her partner Kevin, a bodybuilder and personal trainer, whom she met on a blind date at the gym. An avid advocate of health and fitness, the 31-year-old maintained her routine throughout pregnancy—even amid severe morning sickness—and resolved to return stronger after childbirth. 'I’ve always been interested in health and fitness, but once I became pregnant, I had this crazy idea that I could bounce back—and come back better than ever,' she said. With Kevin as her trainer, Ms. Tyler began moving immediately after birth, walking up to five kilometers daily while pushing her baby in a stroller. 'Because I kept training during pregnancy, my body just bounced back,' she revealed. In just ten weeks, the first-time mother reached peak fitness and competed in the IFBB NSW and National Championships in the novice bikini division. Her transformation, however, drew intense criticism. 'It’s been horrible,' Ms. Tyler admitted. 'Many women are defensive or negative, implying I abandon my baby to spend time in the gym—when I actually train with her. Or that I’m self-obsessed. I think some take it as a personal attack on their choices.' 'Motherhood is so competitive. There’s constant judgment—what to feed your baby, whether you’re ‘doing it right.’ It’s hurtful, but I’m just proud of what I’ve accomplished.' Ms. Tyler refused to take shortcuts and insists her program is entirely achievable for any woman. She trains only a few times a week, incorporates daily cardio, and credits her success largely to diet. She competed in the standard open division—not a ‘bikini mom’ category—because she didn’t want special treatment. 'I wanted to compete against women who trained for a year, even though I only had ten weeks,' she said. As a cosmetic nurse, she has treated countless women for stretch marks and sagging skin caused by rapid weight gain during pregnancy. 'Some people are genetically predisposed, but for me, it was about prioritizing my time.' Kevin, with 20 years as a bodybuilder and 15 as a personal trainer, guided her program. 'It was 90% diet,' Ms. Tyler said. 'People eat so much processed food—it’s devastating to health.' She spent only two to three hours per week in the gym. Her routine included: four weekly strength sessions (alternating legs/glutes and arms/back), daily 5-km walks with the stroller, and three additional cardio sessions at the gym. Breakfast: Water and one scoop of low-carb protein shake with three Weet-Bix. Post-training snack: One serving of Gentec Casein custard (~270 kcal) to satisfy sweet cravings. Four daily meals: 50g lean protein (chicken, lamb, or steak); 100g complex carbs (sweet potato, brown rice, or quinoa); 120g raw vegetables (broccoli, cabbage, spinach, celery, carrots)—increasing to 150g in the final two weeks. 'I didn’t want any special consideration because I’d just had a baby. I was just so proud to compete alongside women who trained for a whole year.' Her advice to other mothers: 'Don’t eat for two the entire pregnancy. Be sensible. Once damage is done, you can’t undo it. I had cravings—but I ate mindfully.' She juggled a master’s degree, full-time hospital work, and a two-hour commute during pregnancy. 'We don’t watch TV in our house—we have one, but it rarely gets used.' 'The key is focusing on what you *can* do—not comparing yourself to others. My diet is strict, but simple and affordable.' Now, Ms. Tyler aims for more competitions and hopes her journey inspires other mothers to believe they, too, can reclaim their strength—without extremes.
translated_content: Kun fem måneder etter å ha født sitt første barn, en jente navngitt Mary-Jane, trådte Catherine Tyler på scenen ved en av Australias største kroppsbyggingskonkurranser. Med vaskede ab og en muskuløs kropp som dreide hoder, var det ingen tegn på at den 31-årige bare hadde ti uker til å forberede seg på en hendelse mange andre hadde trent hele året for. 'Det var så belønnerende og maktfylt å ha kontroll over kroppen min og utseendet mitt,' sa fru Tyler til Daily Mail Australia. Sydney-mamma Catherine Tyler—vist til venstre noen dager før fødselen—deltok i en kroppsbyggingkonkurranse bare fem måneder etter at hennes første barn kom (vist til høyre, fire uker etter fødselen). Fru Tyler trente med vekter helt til hun var åtte og en halv måned gravid og gjorde kardio helt til dagen før hun fødte. Hun ble veiledet av sin partner Kevin, en kroppsbygger og personlig trener, som hun traff på et blindt date på gymmet. En ivrig tilhenger av helse og fitness, beholdt den 31-årige sin rutine gjennom hele svangerskapet—selv i møte med alvorlig morgenkreft—and bestemte seg for å komme tilbake sterkere etter fødselen. 'Jeg har alltid vært interessert i helse og fitness, men når jeg ble gravid, hadde jeg denne gale idéen om at jeg kunne hoppe tilbake—og komme tilbake bedre enn noensinne,' sa hun. Med Kevin som trener, begynte fru Tyler å bevege seg umiddelbart etter fødselen, og gikk opp til fem kilometer daglig mens hun skjøv barnet i en vogn. 'Fordi jeg trente gjennom svangerskapet, sprang kroppen min bare tilbake,' sa hun. I bare ti uker nådde den første gangen moren toppform og deltok i IFBB NSW og nasjonale mesterskapene i novis-bikini-klassen. Hennes transformasjon, imidlertid, trakk intens kritikk. 'Det har vært fryktelig,' sa fru Tyler. 'Mange kvinner er defensive eller negative, og antyder at jeg forlater barnet mitt for å bruke tid i gymmet—når jeg faktisk trener sammen med henne. Eller at jeg er selv-sentrert. Jeg tror noen tar det som et personlig angrep på deres valg.' 'Morlighet er så konkurransedyktig. Det er konstant dømmende—hva du skal matte barnet ditt, om du gjør det riktig. Det er skadelig, men jeg er bare stolt av hva jeg har oppnådd.' Fru Tyler nektet å ta forkortelser og hevder at programmet hennes er fullt ut gjennomførbart for enhver kvinne. Hun trener bare noen ganger i uken, inkluderer daglig kardio, og skylder suksessen sin til kostholdet. Hun deltok i den vanlige åpne klassen—ikke en 'bikini-mor'-kategori—fordi hun ikke ville ha spesiell behandling. 'Jeg ville konkurrere mot kvinner som hadde trent i et år, selv om jeg bare hadde ti uker til å forberede meg,' sa hun. Som kosmetisk sykepleier har hun behandlet mange kvinner for strekkmerker og slapp hud forårsaket av rask vektøkning under svangerskapet. 'Noen mennesker er genetisk predisponert, men for meg handlet det om å prioritere tiden min.' Kevin, med 20 år som kroppsbygger og 15 som personlig trener, veiledet programmet hennes. 'Det var 90 prosent kosthold,' sa fru Tyler. 'Mennesker spiser så mye bearbeidet mat—det er ødeleggende for helsen.' Hun brukte bare to til tre timer i uken i gymmet. Hennes rutine inkluderte: fire ukentlige styrketreninger (skifte mellom ben/lykke og armer/rygg), daglig 5-km-spmning med vognen og tre ekstra kardiosesjoner i gymmet. Frokost: Vand og én skje med lavkarbohydrat-proteinpulver med tre Weet-Bix. Etter trening: Én portjon Gentec Casein-puding (~270 kcal) for å tilfredsstille søte lyster. Fire måltider daglig: 50 g rent protein (kylling, lam eller steik); 100 g komplekse karbohydrater (søtpotet, brunt ris eller quinoa); 120 g rå grønnsaker (brokkoli, hvit og rød kål, spirekål, selleri og gulrot)—økt til 150 g de to siste ukene før konkurransen. 'Jeg ville ikke ha noen spesiell behandling fordi jeg nettopp hadde fått et barn. Jeg var bare så stolt over å kunne konkurrere sammen med kvinner som hadde trent i et helt år.' Hennes råd til andre mødre: 'Ikke spis for to hele veien gjennom svangerskapet. Vær fornuftig. Når skaden er gjort, kan du ikke rette den. Jeg hadde veldig lyster—men jeg spiste bevisst.' Hun håndterte en mastergrad, fulltidsjobb og en to timers pendling under svangerskapet. 'Vi ser ikke TV i huset vårt—vi har én, men den brukes sjelden.' 'Nøkkelen er å fokusere på hva du *kan* gjøre—ikke sammenligne deg selv med andre. Kostholdet mitt er strengt, men enkelt og rimelig.' Nå setter fru Tyler sine øyne på flere konkurranser og håper at hennes reise vil inspirere andre mødre til å tro at de også kan gjenopplive sin styrke—uten ekstremhendelser.

article_content: The first female pilots to join the Chinese aerobatic team took to the skies during the 10th China International Aviation and Aerospace Exhibition in Zhuhai, showcasing their exceptional skills. The event, held from November 11 to 16, featured displays from 700 exhibitors and over 130 aircraft, including the largest military transport jet ever presented at the show. Yu Xu, Tao Jiali, Sheng Yifei, and He Xiaoli are the first women to join the Bayi Aerobatic Team of the People’s Liberation Army (PLA) Air Force. They performed on Tuesday, marking the 65th anniversary of the PLA Air Force’s founding. The airshow also included performances by Russia’s 'Knights' aerobatic team and the United Arab Emirates Air Force. Among the highlights were aerobatic routines and rainbow-colored skywriting by seven J-10 fighter jets flown by the Bayi team. The four female pilots, each with more than 750 flight hours across four aircraft types, wear the same green flight suits and aviator sunglasses as their five male teammates — a uniform style sometimes compared, informally, to the iconic look from the 1986 film Top Gun, though no official link exists. According to Chinese military sources, these are the only four female pilots in China certified to operate third-generation jet fighters. The exhibition also showcased China’s J-31 stealth fighter, developed by AVIC, which performed a demonstration flight. The event coincided with the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit, during which former U.S. President Barack Obama visited Zhuhai. While he was present in the city, there is no confirmed record of his attendance at the airshow itself. China’s defense budget rose to $132 billion in 2014, representing a 12% increase. The United States has previously accused China of underreporting its actual military expenditures by up to 20%.

Yu Xu, Tao Jiali, Sheng Yifei og He Xiaoli er de første kvinnene som har blitt medlemmer av Bayi Akrobatikklaget i Folkets Frigjøringshær (PLA) Luftforsvar. De utførte på tirsdag, som markerte 65-årsdagen for opprettelsen av PLA Luftforsvar. Utstillingen inkluderte også forestillinger fra Russlands 'Riddere'-akrobatikklag og Forente Arabiske Emiraters luftforsvar. Høydepunkter inkluderte akrobatiske rutiner og regnbuefargede skytekster fra syv J-10-jagerfly fløyet av Bayi-laget. De fire kvinnelige pilotene, hver med mer enn 750 flytimer over fire ulike flytypers, bærer samme grønne flydrakter og solbriller som sine fem mannlige kollegaer – en uniformsstil som noen ganger uformelt sammenlignes med det ikoniske utseendet fra filmen Top Gun fra 1986, selv om ingen offisiell kobling eksisterer. Ifølge kinesiske militære kilder er disse de eneste fire kvinnelige pilotene i Kina som er sertifisert til å operere tredje-generasjons jaktfly. Utstillingen viste også Kinas J-31-stealthjakten, utviklet av AVIC, som utførte en demonstrasjonsflyvning. Arrangementet samtidig med Asia-Pasifik Økonomisk Samarbeids (APEC)-toppmøtet, hvor tidligere amerikanske president Barack Obama besøkte Zhuhai. Selv om han var til stede i byen, finnes det ingen bekreftet registrering av hans tilstedeværelse på luftutstillingen. De forente stater har tidligere anklaget Kina for å ha underrapportert sine faktiske militære utgifter med opptil 20 prosent.

article_content: Though it sits rusted and silent in a Chichester barn, this 1959 Mini is anything but ordinary. Built in July of that year — just three months before mass production began — it was the eighth Mini ever made, and today, it holds the rare distinction of being the oldest known example still in its original, unrestored state. With only 30,000 miles on the odometer, the car spent nearly 25 years untouched after being bought in 1986 by David Gallimore from a woman in Bognor Regis. Its 848cc engine hasn't turned over in decades, and the Farina Grey paint peels beneath layers of corrosion, yet every detail remains intact: the original XLL 27 license plate, the single speedometer on the sparse dashboard, even the worn fabric seats. While it’s far from drivable, collectors see immense value in its authenticity. Only three Minis predate it, but all have been fully restored over the years — making this one a time capsule. Designed during the fuel-scarce era following the Suez Crisis, the Mini revolutionized small-car engineering and went on to be named the second most influential vehicle of the 20th century, right after the Ford Model T. Now, Bonhams is preparing to auction it at the Royal Air Force Museum in London on April 30, 2012, with expectations of a £15,000 sale. Whether a buyer aims to restore it to showroom condition or preserve its weathered charm, this Mini offers a direct link to automotive history.
translated_content: Selv om den ligger røstet og stille i en lade i Chichester, er denne Mini fra 1959 alt annet enn vanlig. Den ble produsert i juli samme år — bare tre måneder før serietilvirkningen startet — og var den åttende Mini noensinne laget, og i dag har den den sjeldne statusen som den eldste kjente eksemplaret som fremdeles er i sin opprinnelige, urendrede tilstand. Med bare 30 000 kilometer på kilometertelleren, sto bilen nærmest uforandret i nesten 25 år etter at den ble kjøpt i 1986 av David Gallimore fra en kvinne i Bognor Regis. Motoren på 848 cc har ikke gått i flere tiår, og den opprinnelige fargen Farina Grey skraper av under lag av korrosjon, men alle detaljene er bevart: det opprinnelige registreringsnummeret XLL 27, den enkle hastighetsmåleren på det enkle instrumentpanelet, ja selv de slittede stoffsetene. Selv om den ikke er kjørbar, ser samlevere stor verdi i dens autenticitet. Bare tre Minier er eldre, men alle har blitt fullstendig gjenopprettet gjennom årene — noe som gjør denne til en tidskapsel. Designet under tiden med bensinmangel etter Suez-krisen, revolusjonererte Mini litenbil-teknikken og ble senere kåret til den nest mest innflytelsesrike bilen i det 20. århundre, rett bak Ford Model T. Nå skal Bonhams selge den på Royal Air Force Museum i London den 30. april 2012, med forventninger om en salgspris på 15 000 britiske pund. Uansett om kjøperen vil gjenopprette den til showroom-tilstand eller bevare dens forfaldne charme, gir denne Mini en direkte kobling til bilens historie.

article_content: Kym Ellis, a 30-year-old mother from Chessington, transformed her life after being deeply unsettled by photos from her best friend’s wedding in 2013. At the time, she weighed nearly 18 stone (114 kg) and wore a size 24. The image of herself standing beside the bride—looking heavier than expected—became the catalyst for change. Though she had intended to lose weight before the wedding, Kym continued gaining weight, particularly during her pregnancy with daughter Phoebe. Working long hours for a building company, she relied heavily on convenient, unhealthy meals—including daily Belgian buns and large portions of jarred curry with naan bread and chocolate mousse. Six weeks after the wedding, she joined Slimming World. Shocked to see the scale read 17st 11lb, she committed fully to a new routine: replacing processed snacks with whole foods, controlling portions, and beginning Zumba and pole-dancing classes at her local gym. Within six weeks, she lost over a stone. Over the next year, she shed a total of 5st 6lb, dropping to 12st 5lb and fitting into size 12 clothing. Her new diet includes Weetabix with fruit for breakfast, homemade chicken tikka salad for lunch, and modest portions of chicken and mushroom noodles for dinner. She now snacks only on fresh fruit like nectarines and mangos. Kym credits ongoing support from her friend Michelle Leivers, another slimmer, and her husband Steve for keeping her motivated. She says losing weight hasn’t just changed her body—it’s reshaped her confidence. She no longer avoids photos and enjoys being active with her toddler. Her ultimate goal? Reaching 11 stone. 'It’s not a diet,' she says. 'It’s a lifestyle.'

article_content: In the second quarter of FY24, Bank of Maharashtra (BoM), headquartered in Pune, emerged as the top-performing public sector bank in India, leading all others in loan growth, deposit growth, and overall business expansion. Gross domestic advances surged 23.55% year-on-year to ₹1,83,122 crore by end-September 2023, the highest growth rate among all public sector banks (PSBs). Deposit mobilization rose 22.18% to ₹2,39,298 crore during the same period. Following BoM in advance growth were Indian Overseas Bank (20.29%), Central Bank of India (17.26%), and UCO Bank (16.53%). State Bank of India (SBI), India’s largest lender by asset size, ranked seventh with a 13.21% growth in advances. Despite its lower growth rate, SBI held a massive loan book of ₹28.84 lakh crore, nearly 16 times larger than BoM’s ₹1.75 lakh crore. Similarly, SBI’s deposits totaled ₹45.03 lakh crore, compared to BoM’s ₹2.39 lakh crore. BoM also led in low-cost funding, with a CASA (Current Account and Savings Account) deposit ratio of 50.71%, the highest among PSBs. Central Bank of India followed closely at 49.93%. Driven by robust growth in both lending and deposits, BoM’s total business expanded by 22.77% to ₹4,22,420 crore — the highest in the sector. Bank of Baroda came second with 13.91% growth. Notably, BoM had also topped PSB rankings in Q1 FY24 with similar growth rates of around 25% across key metrics, signaling sustained momentum.

BoM ledet også i lavkostnadsfinansiering med en CASA-andel (kontoer for nåværende og sparekontoer) på 50,71 %, den høyeste blant PSB-er. Central Bank of India fulgte tett med 49,93 %. article_content: Facing rising Ebola concerns, Rwanda has mandated that all visitors from the United States and Spain undergo mandatory self-monitoring for 21 days upon arrival. Travelers must complete a detailed health questionnaire and report their condition daily by phone—even if they show no symptoms. This requirement, announced via the U.S. Embassy in Kigali, applies to anyone who has been in either country within the past 22 days. Rwanda, located roughly 2,600 miles east of Liberia, has not recorded a single case of Ebola. However, it maintains a strict ban on entry for travelers coming from Guinea, Liberia, Senegal, or Sierra Leone during the same timeframe. The policy reflects caution, not panic—especially since both the U.S. and Spain have reported Ebola-related deaths linked to travelers from West Africa. In the U.S., a Liberian national died in Dallas, infecting two nurses who cared for him. In Spain, at least two missionaries contracted Ebola while working in West Africa and later died; one nurse also tested positive. These incidents prompted heightened global vigilance. Meanwhile, a misunderstanding in New Jersey sparked backlash: a school briefly planned daily temperature checks for students after learning two Rwandan children were enrolled. Parents, alarmed by the notice, kept their kids home for 21 days. The school district later apologized, acknowledging it had unintentionally become a symbol of unwarranted fear. In Sierra Leone, the situation remains dire. The outbreak is accelerating westward toward Freetown, with dozens of new cases and up to 20 deaths reported daily. Burial teams are overwhelmed, unable to collect all bodies promptly due to high infection rates and restricted access to homes. The Western Area zones now have 851 confirmed cases—nearly matching the totals in the former epicenters of Kenema and Kailahun in the east. The WHO confirms more than 4,500 deaths globally, almost all concentrated in Liberia, Guinea, and Sierra Leone. As movement increases from rural areas to urban centers like Waterloo and Freetown, containment grows increasingly difficult.

Kravet, som ble annonsert gjennom den amerikanske ambassaden i Kigali, gjelder alle som har vært i ett av disse landene de siste 22 dagene. Rwanda, beliggende omtrent 2 600 kilometer øst for Liberia, har ikke registrert et eneste tilfelle av Ebola. Imidlertid opprettholder landet et strengt innreiseforbud for reisende fra Guinea, Liberia, Senegal eller Sierra Leone i samme tidsrom. Politikken reflekterer forsiktighet, ikke panikk—særskilt siden både USA og Spania har registrert dødsfall forbundet med reisende fra Vest-Afrika. I USA døde en liberiansk statsborger i Dallas og smittet to sykepleiere som passet på ham. I Spania døde minst to misjonærer etter å ha blitt smittet i Vest-Afrika; én sykepleier testet også positivt. Disse hendelsene har ført til økt global varsomhet. Mens dette skjer, utløste en misforståelse i New Jersey en opprør: en skole planla midlertidig daglige temperaturmålinger for elever etter å ha lært at to rwandiske barn var påmeldt. Foreldrene, forferdet av notisen, holdt barna sine hjemme i 21 dager. Skoledistriktet beklaget senere situasjonen og erkjente at de uvisst hadde blitt et symbol på urettferdig frykt. I Sierra Leone er situasjonen fortsatt alvorlig. Utbruddet utvider seg raskt vestover mot Freetown, med dusinvis av nye tilfeller og opptil 20 dødsfall hver dag. Begravelsteam er overbelastet og kan ikke samle inn alle lik fordi infeksjonsraten er høy og tilgangen til hjem er begrenset. De vestlige områdene har nå 851 bekreftede tilfeller—nesten like mange som i de tidligere epicentrene Kenema og Kailahun i øst. Verdens helseorganisasjon bekrefter mer enn 4 500 dødsfall globalt, nesten alle koncentrert i Liberia, Guinea og Sierra Leone. Med økt bevegelse fra landdistrikter til byområder som Waterloo og Freetown blir innhegning stadig vanskeligere.

article_content: A member of the Hell's Angels motorcycle club was charged with assault with a deadly weapon following a violent brawl that escalated into a gunfight, leaving one person dead. Police identified the victim as Jeffrey Pettigrew, 51, president of the San Jose, California, chapter of the Hell's Angels. The incident occurred at John Ascuaga's Nugget Casino Resort in Sparks, Nevada. Two others — both members of the Vagos motorcycle club from California — were hospitalized in stable condition after sustaining gunshot wounds to the abdomen and leg. Cesar Villagrana, 36, was arrested after surveillance footage showed him firing into the crowd during the Friday night altercation. However, police stated it could not yet be confirmed whether his shots struck any victims. Villagrana faces additional charges: carrying a concealed weapon, aiming a firearm at another person, discharging a firearm in a manner endangering others, and possession of a stolen firearm. His bail was set at $500,000 cash only. Authorities urged bystanders who captured photos or videos of the event to contact police. A second shooting occurred at 10:49 a.m. Saturday. A motorcyclist was shot in the stomach as a car pulled alongside him. His identity was withheld, but he remained in stable condition. Witnesses reported seeing a black four-door BMW with two occupants speeding away afterward. Police said they could not definitively link the two shootings. The incidents took place during the Street Vibrations Fall Rally, which began Wednesday and was scheduled to run through Sunday. Following the violence, the Sparks portion of the event was canceled for the remainder of the weekend. Sparks Mayor Geno Martini declared a state of emergency, stating, 'Whenever you have people who enter our city with bad intentions, bad things are going to happen.' The Sparks Police Department increased foot and mobile patrols across the city. Approximately 30 individuals reportedly participated in the casino brawl. Police responded with support from aerial units. Authorities emphasized that the actions of these two clubs do not reflect the majority of law-abiding motorcyclists attending the rally. CNN's Maggie Schneider contributed to this report.

article_content: In 1999, Dr. William Haseltine coined the term 'regenerative medicine' to describe therapies that repair or replace tissues damaged by injury, disease, or aging—including the delicate structures of the eye. Today, this field is rapidly evolving, especially in the fight against glaucoma, one of the world’s top causes of permanent vision loss. With cases projected to surge from 76 million in 2020 to nearly 112 million by 2040, the need for smarter, faster diagnostics has never been greater. Traditional glaucoma screening relies on manual interpretation of eye scans, visual field tests, and pressure measurements—a process prone to human error and inconsistent access. Enter artificial intelligence: researchers from Nanjing Medical University, Wake Forest, and the University of Sydney are now training deep learning models to spot early signs of glaucoma with remarkable precision. These algorithms analyze fundus images, OCT scans, and even areas of the retina beyond the optic nerve head, identifying subtle structural changes invisible to the naked eye. What makes this breakthrough powerful isn’t just accuracy—it’s accessibility. In rural villages or low-income regions where ophthalmologists are scarce, AI-powered tools can bring expert-level screening to a smartphone or tablet. Duke Eye Center findings show these systems outperform traditional methods in both speed and reliability, catching glaucoma earlier and helping prevent irreversible damage. This could slash long-term healthcare costs and narrow the gap in vision care between urban centers and remote communities. But hurdles remain. Without standardized datasets across clinics and countries, AI models risk being biased or unreliable. And even the best algorithm won’t help if frontline health workers lack the devices or training to use them. The future of glaucoma care doesn’t lie solely in code—it lies in building inclusive, adaptable systems that serve everyone, everywhere. As this technology matures, the goal is clear: turn cutting-edge science into equitable, everyday care.
translated_content: I 1999 præsenterte dr. William Haseltine begrepet 'regenerativ medisin' som terapier som reparerer eller erstatter vev skadet av skade, sykdom eller aldring—inkludert de delicate strukturene i øyet. I dag utvikler dette feltet seg raskt, spesielt i kampen mot glaukom, en av verdens fremste årsaker til varig synstap. Antallet tilfeller forventes å stige fra 76 millioner i 2020 til nesten 112 millioner i 2040, og behovet for smartere, raskere diagnostikk har aldri vært større. Tradisjonell skjerming for glaukom bygger på manuell tolkning av øyescanninger, visuelle felttester og trykkmålinger—en prosess som er utsatt for menneskelige feil og ulik tilgang. Her kommer kunstig intelligens: forskere fra Nanjing Medical University, Wake Forest og University of Sydney trener nå dype læringsmodeller til å oppdage tidlige tegn på glaukom med bemerkelsesverdig presisjon. Disse algoritmene analyserer fundusbilder, OCT-scanninger og selv områder i netthinnen utenfor optisk nevshode, og identifiserer subtile strukturelle endringer som er usynlige for det blotte øye. Hva som gjør denne gjennombruddet så kraftfullt, er ikke bare nøyaktigheten—det er tilgjengeligheten. I landsbyer eller lavinntektsregioner der oftalmologer er sjeldne, kan AI-verktøy bringe ekspertnivå-skjerming til en smartphone eller nettbrett. Funnet fra Duke Eye Center viser at disse systemene presterer bedre enn tradisjonelle metoder både i hastighet og pålitelighet, og fanger opp glaukom tidligere og hjelper til med å forhindre uopprettelig skade. Dette kan redusere langtidshelsekostnader og redusere forskjellen i synsomsorg mellom byområder og fjerne kommuner. Men det finnes fremdeles utfordringer. Uten standardiserte datasett over klinikker og land, risikerer AI-modeller å bli foranskjede eller upålitelige. Og selv den beste algoritmen vil ikke hjelpe hvis frontlinjehelsearbeidere mangler enheter eller opplæring til å bruke dem. Fremtiden for glaukomomsorg ligger ikke bare i kode—den ligger i å bygge inkluderende, tilpassbare systemer som tjener alle, overalt. Når teknologien modner, er målet klart: gjøre fremragende vitenskap til jevnlig, rettferdig helseomsorg.

article_content: Jameel Algibhah lives in the Bronx, but hasn't seen his wife and three daughters in Yemen for seven years. Awais Sajjad, from New Jersey, hasn't visited his grandmother — who raised him after his mother’s death — in Pakistan for more than two years. Both men long to reunite with their families, but they are trapped on the U.S. no-fly list — despite never being accused of any threat to aviation security. Their stories are far from unique. Since 9/11, thousands of Americans have been added to the no-fly list without notice, explanation, or meaningful recourse. The government’s official remedy — the TRIP process — requires individuals to submit basic personal details online, then wait for a boilerplate reply: 'No changes are warranted at this time.' In summer 2023, a federal court in Oregon declared the TRIP process unconstitutional, condemning the government for denying citizens a fair chance to challenge their designation. In response, officials pledged to reform the system 'to increase transparency' — a long-overdue step. But transparency alone isn’t enough. Leaked internal guidelines reveal shockingly vague criteria for inclusion on the list — and nearly every nomination submitted by agents is approved. Last year, the screening center rejected just 1% of nominations. Under President Obama, the list ballooned from roughly 4,700 to 47,000 names. Even more troubling: FBI agents have reportedly pressured individuals like Algibhah and Sajjad to become informants within their own communities as a condition for removal. 'I don’t want to become an informant,' Sajjad said. 'But the government says that’s the only way I’ll ever see my family again.' This coercive tactic — confirmed in lawsuits by the CLEAR Project and the Center for Constitutional Rights — exposes a dangerous abuse of power. Meanwhile, the FBI argues its agents should be immune from legal consequences. The no-fly list was meant to protect aviation safety. But when innocent people are barred from flying for years, pressured to betray their communities, and denied basic due process, the system has strayed far from its purpose. Without stricter rules, independent oversight, and accountability for misconduct, no American is truly safe from arbitrary exclusion.

Begge mennene savner å gjenforenes med sine familier, men de er fanget på den amerikanske flyforbudlisten — selv om de aldri har blitt anklaget for noen trussel mot luftfartssikkerhet. Deres historier er langt fra unike. Etter 9/11 har tusenvis av amerikanere blitt lagt til flyforbudlisten uten varsling, forklaring eller meningsfull vei til rettferdighet. Den offisielle løsningen fra regjeringen — TRIP-prosessen — krever at individer sender inn grunnleggende personopplysninger online, så venter de på en standardrespons: 'Ingen endringer er nødvendige for øyeblikket.' article_content: An 11-year-old girl, Paige Warner from Roseville, California, died after suffering a sudden and unexplained allergic reaction during a family vacation in Hawaii. While swimming with her younger sister, Violet, in a Honolulu pool during their Thanksgiving trip, Paige complained that her nose was burning. Within minutes, her throat swelled and she struggled to breathe, her mother, Karin Carpenter, told KTXL. Although Paige had long lived with severe food and environmental allergies, her family had always managed her reactions effectively. This episode was unlike any before. 'This time, I just knew something was wrong,' Carpenter said. Paige told her, 'I'm dying. I know I'm going to die because I can see the look on your face.' Emergency responders were called, and Paige was rushed to the hospital. Her lungs shut down and her heart stopped. Medical staff performed CPR for over an hour. She was placed in a medically induced coma in hopes of recovery, but she passed away days later. Doctors have not identified the trigger for the reaction. Possible causes under consideration include volcanic ash in the air or the temperature of the pool water. A GoFundMe page created by friends and family has raised more than $28,000 to help cover expenses. Tributes describe Paige as a gifted artist and a member of her school band. Carpenter expressed deep gratitude: 'I am in complete shock and awe at this generous outpouring for Paige. I cannot begin to express my thanks to the hundreds who have left messages, donations, and prayers.' Her younger sister, Violet, has become a source of strength for the family. Despite their grief, Violet insisted on putting up Christmas decorations to keep spirits alive. 'She’s been our ray of sunshine, keeping us eating and taking care of ourselves,' Carpenter said. The family plans to hold a funeral for Paige in January.

Innenfor få minutter svulmet halsen hennes, og hun hadde vanskeligheter med å puste, sa moren hennes, Karin Carpenter, til KTXL. Selv om Paige lenge har hatt alvorlige mat- og miljøallergier, har familien alltid klart å kontrollere reaksjonene hennes. Denne episoden var ulik alle tidligere. 'Denne gangen visste jeg bare at noe var galt,' sa Carpenter. Paige sa til henne: 'Jeg dør. Jeg vet jeg skal dø fordi jeg kan se uttrykket på ansiktet ditt.' Ambulanse ble kalt, og Paige ble brakt til sykehuset. Lungene hennes lukket seg, og hjertet hennes stoppet. Medisinsk personell utførte hjertelungeredning i mer enn en time. En GoFundMe-side opprettet av venner og familiemedlemmer har samlet inn mer enn 28 000 dollar for å dekke utgifter. Hyllestene beskriver Paige som en begavet kunstner og medlem av skolebandet. Carpenter uttrykte dypt takknemlighet: 'Jeg er i fullstendig sjokk og begeistret over denne generøse strømmen av støtte til Paige. Jeg kan ikke engang begynne å uttrykke min takk for de hundrevis som har skrevet meldinger, gitt donasjoner og bønnfalt for min søte datter.' article_content: A tiny, 1,600-year-old scrap of papyrus has stirred global controversy by seemingly showing Jesus calling Mary Magdalene 'my wife'—but most experts remain deeply skeptical. Written in ancient Coptic, the 8-by-4-centimeter fragment, examined by Harvard scholar Karen King, contains eight fragmented lines in which Jesus defends Magdalene and says, 'I dwell with her.' While the text echoes themes found in Gnostic gospels like the Gospel of Philip, scholars warn it does not prove Jesus was married—it only reveals that some early Christians believed he was, centuries after his death. Leading specialists have raised red flags. Stephen Emmel from the University of Münster noted oddities in both the handwriting and grammar. Alin Suciu from Hamburg bluntly called it a forgery, citing inconsistencies in the script. Meanwhile, Wolf-Peter Funk stressed the lack of context: 'Thousands of papyrus scraps contain wild claims—it could be anything.' Despite these doubts, respected papyrologists Roger Bagnall and AnneMarie Luijendijk have cautiously endorsed its age and material authenticity, dating it to the latter half of the 4th century, likely from Upper Egypt. Their assessment was based on ink tone, papyrus texture, and scribal style—not the content’s truthfulness. King herself insists the fragment is not evidence of Jesus’s marital status, but rather a window into theological debates of the time. She plans to test the ink to verify its age, noting that the owner wishes to sell it—a detail that fuels suspicions of commercial manipulation. The papyrus’s back side is too damaged to read, except for the words 'my mother' and 'three.' This artifact taps into a long-standing undercurrent in Christian history: the idea that Jesus and Mary Magdalene shared a close bond. Popularized by novels like The Da Vinci Code, this notion challenges the Church’s traditional portrayal of Magdalene as a repentant sinner and upends the ideal of clerical celibacy. Yet, as King points out, the real value lies not in biography, but in understanding how early Christian communities imagined their leader—as human, intimate, and flawed. The fragment’s origins remain mysterious. It arrived at Harvard via an anonymous donor from a bulk lot of ancient texts. A handwritten note—unsigned and undated—claims it’s the only known text where Jesus speaks directly of having a wife. But without verified provenance, many historians urge caution, warning that forged relics have long fueled the black market for antiquities. Ultimately, this scrap may not rewrite history—but it does remind us that history itself was once fiercely contested.

Skrevet i det gamle koptiske språket, inneholder den 8x4 cm store fragmentet, undersøkt av Harvard-forskeren Karen King, åtte fragmenterte linjer der Jesus forsvarer Magdalena og sier: 'Jeg bor med henne.' Selv om teksten henviser til temaer funnet i gnostiske evangeliene som Filippusevangeliet, advarer forskere mot å tolke den som bevis for at Jesus var gift—den viser bare at noen tidlige kristne trodde han var det, århundrer etter hans død. Dette fragmentet knytter seg til en langvarig understrøm i kristen historie: idéen om at Jesus og Maria Magdalena hadde et nært forhold. Det kom til Harvard gjennom en anonym donator fra en stor samling gamle tekster. Et håndskrevet notat—uten signatur eller dato—påstår at det er det eneste kjente dokumentet der Jesus direkte nevner å ha en hustru. Men uten bekreftet opprinnelse, oppfordrer mange historikere til forsiktighet, og varsler at falske relikvier lenge har vært brukt til å drive mørke markedet for antikviteter. I enden av dagen kan dette fragmentet ikke omskrive historien—men det minner oss om at historien selv engang var hardt kjempet.

article_content: Former India cricketer Gautam Gambhir has hailed Shreyas Iyer as the most vital game-changer for Team India in the 2023 ODI World Cup. Speaking on Star Sports, Gambhir highlighted how Iyer fought back from injury to earn his place in the squad — then delivered a blistering century in just 70 balls during the knockout stage. Gambhir emphasized that Iyer’s ability to dominate under pressure will be crucial in the final against Australia, particularly when facing the spin threat of Adam Zampa and the all-round challenge of Glenn Maxwell. On Wednesday, Iyer made history by becoming the first middle-order batsman to score over 500 runs in a single ICC Cricket World Cup edition. So far, he has amassed 526 runs at an average of 75.14 and a strike rate exceeding 113, including two centuries and three half-centuries — with a top score of 128*. His semifinal masterclass against New Zealand saw him smash 105* off 70 balls, featuring eight sixes and four boundaries, at a staggering strike rate of 150. This performance not only extended his purple patch but also broke multiple records in ODI World Cup history. India will face Australia in the final on Sunday at the Narendra Modi Stadium in Ahmedabad — a match where Gambhir believes Iyer’s form could tip the scales in India’s favor.

article_content: The tragic death of 14-year-old Alex Spourdalakis, a non-verbal autistic boy weighing 200 pounds, has exposed the extreme desperation of his mother, Dorothy Spourdalakis, and her godmother, Jolanta Skordzka, who were charged with first-degree murder after killing him in their River Grove, Illinois home. In a handwritten note written before their failed suicide attempt, the women accused the medical system of neglecting Alex — restraining him like an animal, ignoring his physical pain, and subjecting him to psychiatric drugs that worsened his condition. Alex had been hospitalized for severe gastrointestinal distress, often kept in four-point restraints for extended periods without doctor’s orders. His mother insisted his violent outbursts were caused by unmanaged stomach pain, not behavioral issues. Three months before his death, Loyola Gottlieb Memorial Hospital was cited for improperly restraining Alex. Despite her pleas, no facility would accept him, and his insurance denied coverage for continued care. After being discharged and brought home, Alex’s condition deteriorated further. The women, overwhelmed by the demands of 24/7 care, believed they had no other option. A gastric specialist in New York later confirmed Alex suffered from hundreds of tiny, painful stomach ulcers — validating Dorothy’s long-held belief that his suffering was medical, not psychological. In their final moments, the women allegedly stabbed Alex multiple times in the chest, severed his wrist, and killed the family cat to prevent it from being sent to a shelter. They then took sleeping pills and locked themselves in Alex’s room. Alex’s father discovered them unconscious and called emergency services. Both women survived and were charged with murder. Controversial autism researcher Andrew Wakefield, long discredited for falsely linking vaccines to autism, publicly appealed for help to prevent Alex from being placed in long-term psychiatric care — a move that led to his discharge. His involvement has sparked debate over whether his activism helped or hindered the situation. This case underscores a profound crisis in the U.S. healthcare system: the absence of adequate support, funding, and infrastructure for families caring for children with severe disabilities.

I en håndskrevet note skrevet før deres mislykkede selvmordsforsøk, anklaget kvinnene det medisinske systemet for å ha neglisjert Alex — å fange ham som et dyr, å ignorere hans fysiske smerte og å underkaste ham psykiatriske legemidler som forverret hans tilstand. Alex hadde vært sykehusbehandlet for alvorlige gastrointestinale problemer og ofte holdt i firepunktsfikseringer i lengre perioder uten legeordre. Moren hans insisterte på at hans voldelige utbrudd var forårsaket av ubehandlet magepine, ikke atferdsproblemer. Tre måneder før hans død ble Loyola Gottlieb Memorial Hospital kritisert for ugyldig fiksering av Alex. Trods hennes pleie, fant ingen institusjon seg til å ta imot ham, og forsikringen nektet å dekke videre omsorgskostnader. Etter at han ble frigitt og tatt hjem, forverret Alex sin tilstand ytterligere. Kvinnene, overveldet av kravene til 24/7-omsorg, trodde de ikke hadde noen annen mulighet. En magefaglig spesialist i New York bekreftet senere at Alex lider av hundrevis av små, smertefulle mageulser — og verifiserte Dorothy sine lenge holdte overbevisninger om at smerten hans var medisinsk, ikke psykologisk. I sine siste øyeblikk skal kvinnene ha stukket Alex flere ganger i brystet, skåret hans håndnest, og drept huskatte for å unngå at den skulle sendes til et dyrevern. De tok så sovepiller og låste seg inne i Alex’ soverom. Alex’ far oppdaget dem bevisstløse og ringte redningstjenesten. Begge kvinnene overlevde og ble tiltalt for mord. Den kontroversielle autismeforskeren Andrew Wakefield, som lenge har blitt diskreditert for å ha feilaktig knyttet vaksiner til autisme, gjorde et offentlig opprop for å hindre Alex fra å bli plassert i langvarig psykiatrisk omsorg — et skritt som førte til hans frigivelse. Hans involvering har utløst debatt om hans aktivisme hjalp eller skadet situasjonen. Dette tilfellet understreker en dyb krisen i det amerikanske helsevesenet: mangel på tilstrekkelig støtte, finansiering og infrastruktur for familier som omsørger barn med alvorlige funksjonsnedsettelser.

article_content: The body of Fehmina Chaudhry, a 27-year-old Pakistani-born model living in Singapore, was discovered in a ditch on the outskirts of Islamabad on Tuesday. She had gone missing the previous week while visiting Pakistan to explore property purchases for her mother. Local authorities say Maaz Waqar, a real estate agent, confessed to her abduction, attempted ransom, and subsequent murder following interrogation. Chaudhry, originally from Karachi and a mother of two, was known not only for her modeling career but also for her dedication to community work — including plans to open a fashion school in Pakistan. Her promoter, Asif Hashmi, confirmed her death and highlighted her achievements in beauty pageants and humanitarian efforts. According to police, Chaudhry’s mother last spoke to her on October 10, after which she received a text claiming her daughter had been kidnapped. Police traced Waqar, who admitted to killing Chaudhry and disposing of her body near a stream outside the city. She had been staying at a private hotel during her trip, which was part of her regular visits to see family and manage personal investments.

Lokale myndigheter sier at Maaz Waqar, en fast eiendomsforvalter, har innrømmet at han kidnappet, forsøkte å kreve løsepengene og deretter drepte henne etter forhør. Chaudhry, opprinnelig fra Karachi og mor til to barn, var kjent ikke bare for sin modellkarriere, men også for sitt engasjement i samfunnsarbeid — inkludert planer om å åpne en mode-skole i Pakistan. Hennes promotør, Asif Hashmi, bekreftet døden og fremhevet hennes prestasjoner i skjønnhetskonkurranser og humanitære innsats. Ifølge politiet talte Chaudhrys mor med henne sist den 10. oktober, etterfulgt av en tekstmelding som sa at datteren var blitt kidnappet. Politiet sporet Waqar, som innrømmet at han hadde drept Chaudhry og kastet kroppen nær en strøm utenfor byen. Hun hadde vært i et privat hotell under reisen, som var en del av hendes vanlige besøk for å treffe familie og håndtere personlige investeringer.

article_content: Austin, Texas (CNN) — Even though he cannot set foot in the United States for fear of arrest, fugitive National Security Agency whistleblower Edward Snowden has been added to the speaker lineup for this year’s South by Southwest Interactive Festival. Snowden, who fled the U.S. in June 2013 with thousands of classified documents, will appear via teleconference from Russia to discuss how the tech community can defend itself against mass surveillance. He will speak with Christopher Soghoian, principal technologist at the American Civil Liberties Union’s Speech, Privacy and Technology Project. "The conversation will focus on the impact of the NSA’s surveillance activities on the technology sector and how technology can help protect users from mass monitoring," according to an SXSW press release. Audience members will be able to ask questions, and The Texas Tribune, a nonprofit news organization, plans to livestream the session. Josh Baer, a tech entrepreneur with over 15 years of SXSW attendance, said he looks forward to hearing Snowden’s perspective. "The news and the government each offer vastly different narratives," Baer said. "It’s always refreshing to hear directly from the source." Hugh Forrest, director of SXSW Interactive, said securing Snowden’s participation took more than three months and called it essential to this year’s program. "The rise of social media has driven much of the growth of the online ecosystem, but the revelations from summer 2013 exposed its hidden costs," Forrest said. He added that Snowden aims to engage a tech-savvy audience on the need to build next-generation tools that safeguard user privacy. Privacy and government surveillance are recurring themes at this year’s festival, with additional speakers including journalist and civil liberties lawyer Glenn Greenwald and WikiLeaks founder Julian Assange. Both Greenwald and Assange helped Snowden publish the leaked NSA documents and will also appear remotely. Greenwald relocated to Rio de Janeiro, the home city of his partner, David Miranda. Assange was granted diplomatic asylum at the Ecuadorian Embassy in London after Sweden sought to question him in connection with a sexual assault investigation. Snowden, a former CIA employee and NSA contractor, was granted temporary asylum in Russia last year. He faces felony charges of espionage and theft of government property in the U.S. and has stated he will not return until American whistleblower protection laws are reformed. "Surveillance and online privacy are expected to be among the most discussed topics at the 2014 SXSW Interactive Festival," a festival statement reads. "As organizers, SXSW believes that a robust public debate on the limits of surveillance is vital to the future of the online ecosystem." SXSW annually hosts film, music, and interactive festivals, drawing tens of thousands to Austin. This year’s 10-day event begins Friday.

Snowden, som flyktet fra USA i juni 2013 med tusener av klassifiserte dokumenter, vil delta via videokonferanse fra Russland for å diskutere hvordan teknologisamfunnet kan beskytte seg mot masseovervåking. Han vil snakke med Christopher Soghoian, hovedteknolog ved American Civil Liberties Unions prosjekt for tale, privatliv og teknologi. "Samtalen vil fokusere på effekten av NSA’s overvåkingsaktiviteter på teknologisektoren og hvordan teknologi kan hjelpe brukere å beskytte seg mot masseovervåking," sier en SXSW-pressmeddelelse. Publikum vil kunne stille spørsmål, og The Texas Tribune, et ikke-kommersielt nyhetsorgan, planlegger å streame økten live. Josh Baer, en tech-entreprenør med mer enn 15 år med opplevelse fra festivalen, sier at han ser frem til å høre Snowdens perspektiv. "Nyhetene og regjeringen har veldig ulike fortellinger," sa Baer. "Det er alltid givende å høre direkte fra kilden." Hugh Forrest, leder for SXSW Interactive, sa at det tok mer enn tre måneder å sikre Snowdens deltagelse og kalte det essensielt for dette årets program. "Veksten i sosiale medier har drivet mye av veksten i det digitale økosystemet, men avsløringene fra sommeren 2013 avdekket dets skjulte kostnader," sa Forrest. Han la til at Snowden ønsker å engasjere et teknisk orientert publikum om nødvendigheten av å bygge neste generasjon verktøy som beskytter brukerens privatliv. Privatliv og statslig overvåking er gjentatte temaer på dette årets festival, med flere talere inkludert journalisten og borgerrettsadvokaten Glenn Greenwald og WikiLeaks-grunnleggeren Julian Assange. Både Greenwald og Assange hjalp Snowden med å publisere de stjålne NSA-dokumentene og vil også delta via videokonferanse. Greenwald flyttet til Rio de Janeiro, hjembyen til sin partner, David Miranda. Assange ble gitt diplomatisk asyl i Den ecuadorianske ambassaden i London etter at Sverige søkte å forhøre ham i forbindelse med en seksuell overgrepssak. Snowden, en tidligere CIA-ansatt og NSA-utsending, fikk midlertidig asyl i Russland i fjor. Han står overfor forbrytelser av spionasje og tyveri av statlige eiendeler i USA og har sagt at han ikke vil komme tilbake før amerikanske lover for beskyttelse av avslørere blir reformert. "Overvåking og online-privatliv forventes å være blant de mest diskuterte emnene på SXSW Interactive Festival 2014," sier en festivalmelding. "Som arrangører mener SXSW at en robust offentlig debatt om grensene for overvåking er avgjørende for fremtiden for det digitale økosystemet." SXSW arrangerer hvert år film-, musikk- og interaktive fester, og trekker titusenvis av deltakere til Austin. Dette årets ti dagers arrangement starter fredag.

article_content: Anthony Mangione, the former head of Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) in South Florida, has been arrested on federal charges related to child pornography, the Department of Justice announced Wednesday. The 50-year-old from Parkland, Florida, faces three counts: transporting, receiving, and possessing child pornography, according to an indictment unsealed this week. Authorities allege that between March and September 2010, Mangione used electronic devices to transport and receive visual depictions of minors engaged in sexually explicit conduct, and stored additional illegal images on his home computer. Mangione was taken into custody by FBI agents on Tuesday and appeared in federal court in West Palm Beach on Wednesday, where he pleaded not guilty. Both prosecutors and his defense attorney, David Howard, requested a psychological evaluation, which the judge granted. Howard expressed concern about Mangione’s mental state, citing the severity of the charges. A 27-year law enforcement veteran, Mangione appeared in court wearing a gray jumpsuit marked 'federal prisoner' and was shackled. He did not speak during the hearing and is currently held in Broward County Jail. Court records indicate he has been on paid administrative leave since April, following a federal probe into four child pornography images allegedly received via email. ICE, the agency Mangione once led, publicly champions efforts like Operation Predator — a nationwide initiative targeting child predators, sex tourists, and human traffickers. In a brief statement, ICE Director John Morton acknowledged cooperation with investigators but declined further comment. The case is being jointly investigated by the FBI and the Broward County Sheriff’s Office. If convicted, Mangione could face up to 20 years in prison, followed by five years to life of supervised release, and mandatory registration as a sex offender.

Myndighetene hevder at Mellom mars og september 2010 brukte Mangione elektroniske enheter til å transportere og motta visuelle fremstillinger av mindreårige som deltok i seksuelt eksplisitt oppførsel, og lagret ytterligere ulovlige bilder på sin hjemme-datamaskin. Anklager og forsvarer David Howard ba begge om en psykologisk vurdering, som dommeren godkjente. Howard uttrykte bekymring for Mangiones mentale helse og henviset til alvorligheten av anklagene. En 27 år lang erfaren lovtjenestemann, opptrådte Mangione i retten i en grå overrøyk med merket 'føderal fange' og var fengslet. Han sa ingenting under forhandlingene og er for øyeblikket holdt i Broward County fengsel. Domstolsopplysninger viser at han har vært på betalt administrativ permisjon siden april, etter en føderal etterforskning av fire barneporno-bilder som antas å ha blitt mottatt via e-post. I en kort uttalelse erkjente ICE-direktør John Morton samarbeidet med etterforskningen, men nektet videre kommentar. Saken undersøkes felles av FBI og Broward County politistasjon. Hvis han blir funnet skyldig, kan Mangione få opptil 20 års fengsel, fulgt av fem år til livstid med overvåking, og plikt til registrering som seksualforbryter.
